```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x
result <- params$result
config <- params$config
```

# Processing summary

This report documents GasBench sample selection, run drift adjustment,
linearity correction, scale calibration, and exclusions.

## Experiment

```{r experiment}
processing <- config$processing %||% list()
experiment_info <- data.frame(
  Field = c("Experiment", "File", "Peripheral", "Element", "Isotope"),
  Value = c(
    config$experiment_name %||% NA_character_,
    config$file_name %||% NA_character_,
    "GB",
    processing$element %||% NA_character_,
    if (nrow(result$data) > 0) result$data$isotope[[1]] else NA_character_
  )
)
knitr::kable(experiment_info)
```

## Correction stages

```{r corrections}
correction_file <- params$corrections_file
if (!is.null(correction_file) && file.exists(correction_file)) {
  knitr::kable(utils::read.csv(correction_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
}
```

## Drift correction

The run drift model is fitted to one mean per selected standard analysis and
applied by instrument analysis number. Analyses outside the fitted range are
marked in the processed data.

```{r drift-details}
drift <- result$drift_correction
drift_info <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "Applied", "Reason", "Standard", "Standard analyses",
    "Analysis range", "Reference delta", "Slope per analysis",
    "R-squared", "Slope p-value", "Residual SD", "Extrapolated rows"
  ),
  Value = c(
    drift$applied %||% FALSE,
    drift$reason %||% NA_character_,
    drift$standard_id %||% NA_character_,
    drift$n_standard_analyses %||% NA_integer_,
    paste(drift$analysis_range, collapse = " to "),
    drift$reference_delta %||% NA_real_,
    drift$slope_per_analysis %||% NA_real_,
    drift$r_squared %||% NA_real_,
    drift$slope_p_value %||% NA_real_,
    drift$residual_sd %||% NA_real_,
    drift$extrapolated_rows %||% 0L
  )
)
knitr::kable(drift_info)
if (is.data.frame(drift$standard_analyses) && nrow(drift$standard_analyses) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(drift$standard_analyses)
}
```

## Linearity calibration

The calibration uses the configured sample peak range. The model and status
below record whether area-dependent correction was applied.

```{r linearity}
linearity <- result$linearity_model
if (!is.null(linearity)) {
  linearity_info <- data.frame(
    Metric = c("Calibration standard", "Delta column", "Slope", "Intercept", "R-squared", "Calibration rows"),
    Value = c(
      linearity$calibration_standard,
      linearity$delta_column,
      linearity$slope,
      linearity$intercept,
      linearity$r_squared,
      linearity$n_stds
    )
  )
  knitr::kable(linearity_info)
  if (!is.null(linearity$plot)) print(linearity$plot)
} else {
  cat("Linearity calibration was not fitted. Status: ",
      result$linearity_correction$reason %||% "not available", ".", sep = "")
}
```

## Scale calibration

The scale model is fit to standard means grouped by injection, then applied to
the corrected sample peak data.

```{r scale}
scale_model <- result$scale_model
if (!is.null(scale_model)) {
  scale_info <- data.frame(
    Metric = c("Measured delta column", "Reference delta column", "Slope", "Intercept", "R-squared", "Standard injections"),
    Value = c(
      scale_model$delta_column,
      scale_model$reference_column,
      scale_model$slope,
      scale_model$intercept,
      scale_model$r_squared,
      scale_model$n_stds
    )
  )
  knitr::kable(scale_info)
  knitr::kable(scale_model$stds_data)
} else {
  cat("Scale calibration was not fitted. Status: ",
      result$scale_correction$reason %||% "not available", ".", sep = "")
}
```

## Exclusions

```{r exclusions}
exclusion_counts <- data.frame(
  Exclusion = c("Name-filtered rows", "Analysis-number exclusions", "Peaks outside sample range"),
  Rows = c(
    nrow(result$excluded_data),
    nrow(result$excluded_analyses),
    nrow(result$excluded_peaks)
  )
)
knitr::kable(exclusion_counts)
```
